newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open flat to firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open flat to firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open flat to slightly firmer on Wednesday as labor leaders at Escondida mine in Chile recommended that workers accept their pay offer in a vote today.
The cash to three months backwardation on LME remained firm at $133/$135 following the sharp gains on Monday and Tuesday.
LME stocks fell 1,025 tonnes to 149,100 tonnes Wednesday.
COMEX copper stocks fell 30 short tons to 48,733 short tons Tuesday.
COMEX May copper was seen opening flat to up 0.40 per pound from Tuesday's close, after trading between 110.20 and 109.50 cents in overnight ACCESS trade.
